description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side to rear extensions; outbuilding at rear for use incidental to main dwelling (Demolition of attached garage and rear patio)
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-fareast;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The proposed alterations, specifically the
change in height and form of the roof, by reason of its uncharacteristic design,
would unbalance the pair of semi-detached properties and result in an incongruous
form of development which would fail to respect the character, composition and
design of the host dwellinghouse and neighbouring properties. The proposal
would therefore result in a detrimental impact to the character and appearance
of the subject dwellinghouse and the character of the surrounding area,
contrary to the high quality design aspirations of National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D.1, D.11 and D.12) of the London Plan (2021), Policy
GR1 of the Local Plan (2021 – 2041) and the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
